view: close three-quarter front, camera slightly below chin height; no tie; collar stand unbuttoned with band ends parted ~3 cm so both rounded ends, both buttons and both buttonholes read; collar leaves folded normally

geometry.collar_type: Classic point collar with folded leaves and moderate spread, single-row edge topstitching, exactly as drawn in the blueprint.
geometry.stand: Extra-tall two-button collar stand (~4.5 cm at center front, ~1.5x a standard one-button stand). BOTH front ends of the band are ROUND: one continuous convex curve (~1.5 cm radius) sweeping from the band's top edge into the neckline seam. No straight vertical front edge; no sharp corner anywhere on either band end.
geometry.buttons: EXACTLY TWO stand buttons, stacked vertically on the center-front line, centers ~1.5 cm apart; wearer's right band end carries the two sewn buttons, wearer's left band end carries two matching horizontal buttonholes. Never one, never three, never side by side.
geometry.placket: Below the stand: standard sewn button placket with TWO parallel vertical topstitch rows and the first placket button visible (blueprint draws the front placket dash-stitched on both edges).
geometry.annotation_semantics: Red outline and red-filled buttons in the blueprint are tech-pack highlights marking the featured component (the stand and its two buttons); render as real white shirting, never as red fabric. Dashed lines are real topstitch rows.

visibly_distinguishes_from_siblings.cs-round: Single-button round stand: shorter band (~3 cm) with ONE button — mine is visibly taller and carries TWO stacked buttons.
visibly_distinguishes_from_siblings.cs-square-2btn: Identical tall two-button band but with straight vertical front edges and crisp 90-degree corners — mine shows zero straight corners, only convex curves.
visibly_distinguishes_from_siblings.cs-left-sq-rt-rnd: Asymmetric (one square end, one round end) — mine is symmetric, both ends round.
visibly_distinguishes_from_siblings.csh-50: That option's feature is raw 5.0 cm stand height with standard end/closure; mine is defined by the round end profile plus the exact two-button closure at ~4.5 cm.

uncertain: Blueprint carries no printed dimensions; 4.5 cm stand height, 1.5 cm button spacing and 1.5 cm end radius are inferred from drawn proportions and standard two-button-stand practice.
